FORMAT LAW. Honour the grammar of the tiny-food miniature cooking — its native framing, its edit rhythm, and the specific thing audiences expect from it. If the format loops, the last frame must match the first.

CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a gimbal glide tracking laterally at a constant stand-off on a 50mm anamorphic with 2x squeeze, framing with deep negative space above the subject with a low horizon.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.
